
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_sessions.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("amount") <= 984).filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull()).alias("o"),
        (F.col("o.customer_id") == F.col("s.customer_id"))
        & (F.col("o.order_date") <= F.date_sub(F.col("s.started_at"), 14)),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.country"), F.col("s.started_at"))
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)
```

```sql
SELECT s.id, s.delivered_date, s.carrier
FROM shipments s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.id = s.order_id
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-07-26'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN s.shipped_date AND s.delivered_date
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM payments p
    WHERE p.order_id = s.order_id
)
ORDER BY delivered_date
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("order_date") <= "2025-07-26").alias("o"),
        (F.col("o.id") == F.col("s.order_id"))
        & (F.col("o.order_date").between(F.col("s.shipped_date"), F.col("s.delivered_date"))),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .join(df_payments.alias("p"), F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("s.order_id"), "left_anti")
    .select(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.delivered_date"), F.col("s.carrier"))
    .orderBy("delivered_date")
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT mgr.id, mgr.job_title, mgr.level, mgr.salary
    FROM employees mgr
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM employees r
        WHERE r.manager_id = mgr.id
          AND mgr.hire_date >= r.hire_date
          AND r.salary <= 63157
    )
)
SELECT job_title, level, MAX(salary) AS max_salary
FROM filtered
GROUP BY job_title, level;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_employees.alias("mgr")
    .join(
        df_employees.filter(F.col("salary") <= 63157).alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.manager_id") == F.col("mgr.id"))
        & (F.col("mgr.hire_date") >= F.col("r.hire_date")),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .select(F.col("mgr.id"), F.col("mgr.job_title"), F.col("mgr.level"), F.col("mgr.salary"))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("job_title", "level")
    .agg(F.max(F.col("salary")).alias("max_salary"))
)
```

```sql
SELECT o.id, o.amount, o.status
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.unit_price <= 225
      AND oi.order_id = o.id
      AND oi.unit_price < o.amount
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payments p
    WHERE p.order_id = o.id
      AND p.status IN ('REFUNDED', 'SUCCESS')
      AND p.amount < o.discount * 1.2
      AND p.status <> 'FAILED'
)
ORDER BY status, id
LIMIT 3
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(
        df_order_items.filter(F.col("unit_price") <= 225).alias("oi"),
        (F.col("oi.order_id") == F.col("o.id")) & (F.col("oi.unit_price") < F.col("o.amount")),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .join(
        df_payments.filter(F.col("status").isin("REFUNDED", "SUCCESS")).filter(F.col("status") != "FAILED").alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("o.id")) & (F.col("p.amount") < F.col("o.discount") * 1.2),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(F.col("o.id"), F.col("o.amount"), F.col("o.status"))
    .orderBy("status", "id")
    .limit(3)
)
```
